set.body:
Scheduling lane: film. Current plan: docs/refactor/PLAN.md. Live dependency edges supersede historical sequencing below.

Current disposition, 2026-09-19; governing docs/refactor/PLAN.md.
Preserved approved film-library scope. Follow S0-S4c order and exact text parity; the earlier annotation preview does not close this ticket.

Original scope retained below for evidence; fleet procedure/assignments are historical and do not govern single-developer work.

Plan: docs/plans/2026-09-18-best-recall-to-video-mapper.md docs/plans/2026-09-17-d1a-source-to-story-plan.md §2.2-2.3, §3 S4b.

StoryModel holds the sealed atlas; text access is a witness minted from the model's own atlas. The D1A plan orders S3 and S4a (either order) before S4b.

Scope:
story, codec, view, pipeline, docs-site, laws, embed-bench, one align call site.

Acceptance criteria:
1. StoryModel holds the sealed atlas; source moves into StoryText; draft adds the membership, projectability and receipt-join checks.
2. Non-text identity is a named content address over bundle id, primary-axis id, sorted mappings and surface checksum; court: two filmEdition bundles sharing a truncated bundle id but differing in timebase or extent give different storyIds; a mutation dropping the axis id fails it; a second court for two surface checksums.
3. StoryText, TextModel and asText (Some iff the atlas is a TextNarrativeAtlas) exist; validate and adjudicated have TextModel overloads; the compiler's text path yields a TextModel.
4. Every text-only consumer listed in the D1A plan §2.3 takes TextModel; supporting, covering and situationsCovering move behind it.
5. Validator: text checks move behind the witness; member-within-parent is re-expressed on the projection; ContextFrame, CircumstanceEdge, claim-evidence and boundary-belief anchors are bound-checked.
6. Probes: StoryText and TextModel have no public door; node types get construction probes recording what stays open; a negative compile assertion (StoryModel is not a TextModel) with a same-shape positive control.
7. The S0 pins are unchanged.

Gate (AGENTS.md SD2/SD6): `sbt -batch clean compileAll testAll` on the merge result, then
`sbt -batch scalafmtCheckAll scalafmtSbtCheck` as a separate run; every test task in build.sbt's
testAll alias reports bound totals (56 at 0e36a7fa, after the corpus modules were added; recount if
modules change); a named mutation witness per new guard, and each compile-time-probe mutation proved
after its own clean recompile; `cd docs-site && npm run verify:examples` when public API or examples
change; fresh-context cold review in a separate pass; the commit body states the evidence and what
it does not establish.

Size: L.
set.title: [film] D1A-types S4b: envelope, non-text identity, and the TextModel witness
